source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 8 august — «Sfântul Ierarh Calinic al Edessei»

attestations.note: His own page gives the same day and its origin: «Pe 23 iunie 2020, Patriarhia Ecumenică a hotărât canonizarea Mitropolitului Calinic al Edessei, Pellei și Almopiei (1919-1984) și pomenirea lui în fiecare an la data de 8 august, ziua slăvitei sale adormiri».

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 8ης Αυγούστου — «Άγιος Καλλίνικος Μητροπολίτης Εδέσσης, Πέλλης και Αλμωπίας»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 8 Αυγούστου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder's Romanian row already carries, and its head line «(1919 - 1984)» agrees with the folder's dates. It is the same man: «Ο εν αγίοις Μητροπολίτης Εδέσσης, Πέλλης και Αλμωπίας Καλλίνικος (κατά κόσμον Δημήτριος) Πούλος», born at Sitaralona of Agrinio on 26 January 1919, elected Metropolitan of Edessa and Pella on 24 June 1967, who «Εκοιμἡθη την 8η Αὐγούστου 1984 μ.Χ. μετά από επτάμηνη ασθένεια». The page prints the synodal communiqué of 23 June 2020 by which the Ecumenical Patriarchate numbered him among the saints. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page. The page prints an apolytikion and a kontakion, both proper to him and both taken here; it also prints a megalynarion, an oikos, four kathismata and four idiomela of the litany, which are not kinds the schema holds and are not drafted.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (24 September 2026).

hymns.text: Pe păstorul Edessei, pe Ierarhul cel lăudat și strălucitorul luceafăr cel a toată Biserica, pe Sfântul Calinic să îl cinstim, pe călăuzitorul tuturor, că se roagă fără-ncetare pentru toți cei ce îi strigă pururea: Slavă lui Hristos, Celui ce te-a slăvit, slavă Celui ce te-a arătat, slavă Celui ce pururea ne dă vindecări cu solirea ta.

source.text: doxologia.ro, «Troparul Sfântului Ierarh Calinic al Edessei», Glas 1

english.text: Let us honour the shepherd of Edessa, the praised hierarch and shining morning star of the whole Church, Saint Callinicus, the guide of all; for he prays without ceasing for all who cry out to him always: Glory to Christ who glorified you, glory to him who made you manifest, glory to him who through your intercession gives healing to us all.

hymns.text: Τῆς Ἐδέσσης ποιμένα, Ἀρχιθύτην πανεύφημον, καὶ τῆς Ἐκκλησίας ἁπάσης, τὸ λαμπρὸν σεμνολόγημα, Καλλίνικον τιμήσωμεν πιστοί, τοῦ κλήρου καὶ λαοῦ τὸν ποδηγόν, ὡς πρεσβεύοντα ἀπαύστως ὑπὲρ αὐτῶν, τῶν ἐκβοώντων πάντοτε. Δόξα τῷ σὲ δοξάσαντι Χριστῷ, δόξα τῷ σὲ ἀναδείξαντι, δόξα τῷ ἐνεργοῦντι διὰ σοῦ πᾶσιν ἰάματα.

source.text: saint.gr, Ἀπολυτίκιον (Κατέβασμα), Ἦχος α΄, Τῆς ἐρήμου πολίτης — on the page of «Άγιος Καλλίνικος Μητροπολίτης Εδέσσης, Πέλλης και Αλμωπίας», and it names him and his see

english.text: Let us the faithful honour Callinicus, the shepherd of Edessa, the all-lauded high priest and the bright boast of the whole Church, the guide of clergy and of people, as one who intercedes unceasingly for them who cry out always: glory to Christ who glorified you, glory to him who showed you forth, glory to him who through you works healings for all.

hymns.text: Τὸν μιμητὴν τοῦ Σωτῆρος Καλλίνικον, καὶ τῆς Ἐδέσσης ποιμένα τὸν ἄριστον, καὶ Ἐκκλησίας ἁπάσης τὸ σέμνωμα, ὑμνολογήσωμεν πάντες φιλάγιοι, ἡμῶν γὰρ ἐδείχθη τὸ στήριγμα.

source.text: saint.gr, Κοντάκιον, Ἦχος β΄, Τοῖς τῶν αἱμάτων σου — on the page of «Άγιος Καλλίνικος Μητροπολίτης Εδέσσης, Πέλλης και Αλμωπίας», and it names him and his see

english.text: Let all we who love the saints hymn Callinicus, the imitator of the Saviour, the excellent shepherd of Edessa and the honour of the whole Church, for he has been shown to be our support.
